summary: A two-wheel baseball / softball pitching machine on a tripod: three splayed legs with rubber feet and braces… joints head_pan, head_tilt, wheel_l, wheel_r; options guard; sockets socket_release, socket_operator, release.
setup: Spawn it with Prefabs.pitching_machine or place "prefab": "pitching_machine" in a scene; Game(plugins=[...]) needs physics3d().
